matter_background.original:
Gamini Perera and his predecessors in title had been in undisturbed and uninterrupted possession in premises bearing Assessment No. 20, High-level Road, Gangodawila, Nugegoda which possession is adverse and independent to that of any other for over 40 years of the land marked Lot A depicted in Survey Plan No. 1234 dated 15/3/1995 made by Anil Silva Licensed Surveyor in extent of 22 perches of the land called Kahatagahawatta situated in Gangodawila in the Palle Pattu of Salpiti Korale in the District of Colombo Western Province.

He consults you as a Notary.
